description: Tier 3 Polish - Part 1: Dark/light theme toggle, Responsive design, Keyboard shortcuts, Framer Motion animations. Covers Tier 3 items #1-4.
steps: Update the existing theme system to add a persistent toggle: create src/shared/components/ui/theme-toggle.tsx that saves preference to localStorage (and DB when available). Verify WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios for both themes. The theme system already exists (dark/light) but ensure the toggle is visible in the header and the preference persists across sessions.

Implement responsive design improvements across all major pages: (a) Sidebar collapses to hamburger menu on mobile (<768px), (b) Dashboard cards stack vertically on tablet (768-1023px) and mobile, (c) Question bank interface adapts to mobile with swipe navigation, (d) All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile. Update src/shared/components/layout/sidebar.tsx, header.tsx, mobile-bottom-nav.tsx.

Enhance keyboard shortcuts system: verify j/k navigation works on all list views (questions list, flashcards, resources), / focuses search, b toggles bookmark on current item, n opens note editor, ? opens help modal. The shortcut system exists in src/app/(protected)/keyboard-shortcuts-provider.tsx - ensure all shortcuts are wired to actual functionality, not just registered.

Add Framer Motion animations to key interactions: page transitions (fade in 150ms), component mount animations (slide up 200ms), card flips (for flashcards, 300ms), modal open/close (scale + fade 200ms). Add respect for prefers-reduced-motion media query (disable all animations when set). Framer Motion is already in package.json. Create src/shared/components/ui/animated-page.tsx wrapper and src/shared/components/ui/animated-card.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Theme toggle visible in header, persists preference, both themes meet WCAG AA contrast
Sidebar collapses to hamburger on mobile, touch targets are 44x44px minimum
Dashboard and question bank layouts adapt to tablet and mobile viewports
Keyboard shortcuts (j/k/b/n/?) trigger actual functionality on relevant pages
Page transitions animate with fade, modals animate with scale+fade
Animations disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is set
All TypeScript compiles, tests pass, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
